name: 37091 · Lewisburg, TN
findings: ZIP 37091 (Lewisburg) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37091 (Lewisburg) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
47% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 37091 (Lewisburg) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 49% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 59% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
